name: YJ Fisher Cube V3
description: The YJ Fisher Cube V3 is a classic 3x3 shape mod that adds a fun twist to solving. Its off-center cuts turn the familiar cube into a whole new visual challenge, with interesting shapes and tricky piece orientation. It solves like a standard 3x3, but the shape shifting adds an extra layer of excitement. A great pick for puzzlers who want something familiar but fresh.
